title: Supervised Production V1 Discovery Lead
description: One untrusted nomination extracted from a bounded Gmail alert observation. Stores source provenance and explicit unresolved states. Must never invent a missing exact-role identifier.

discovery_lead_id.description: Deterministic identifier derived from source + source_message_id + ordinal position within the message. Stable across reprocessing for idempotency.

source.description: Slice 1 supports only the Gmail intake adapter.

source_message_id.description: Provider message identity. Never a spreadsheet ID, account ID, or credential.

observed_at.description: Timestamp the observation was made available to the deterministic core, not a source-claimed posting age.

discovery_urls.description: Absolute http/https URLs observed in the alert. Empty when none were present or none were well-formed.

employer_text.description: Untrusted employer name text as observed. Descriptive only; never Employer Truth.

role_text.description: Untrusted role title text as observed. Descriptive only; never Match Truth.

requisition_text.description: Untrusted free text that may contain a requisition/opportunity identifier.

source_claims.description: Untrusted source-provided claims preserved as observation provenance only; never Employer Truth or Match Truth.

exact_employer_identity.description: Exact employer/application-system identity deterministically parsed from a known ATS URL pattern (e.g. Workday tenant, Greenhouse board, Lever company slug). Null when unresolved; never a fuzzy company-name guess.

exact_requisition_id.description: Exact requisition/opportunity identifier deterministically parsed from URL or requisition_text. Null when absent or ambiguous; never fabricated.

identity_resolution_status.description: RESOLVED only when both exact_employer_identity and exact_requisition_id are present.
